description:
I'm Elva, from portlaoise. I'm a solo team.

I'm someone who thinks a lot. I think about space, about the future, about who I want to be.

I'm here because I want to see if this can change my world. I want to see if I can become someone I dreamed of being.
summary: The Little Rover That Changed How We See Mars is an interactive storytelling experience about Sojourner, NASA's first rover on Mars. Sojourner landed with the Mars Pathfinder mission in 1997. It was built to work for only 7 days, but it kept working for 83 days. It took pictures, explored the surface, and tested rocks and soil before it stopped talking to Earth. Our project tells Sojourner's story in its own voice, using true facts from NASA. It helps people feel what it was like to be small, brave, and alone on another planet, instead of just reading facts. Sojourner was left behind on Mars, but it was never forgotten. Because it stayed, every rover after it could go further. Our project shows how one small rover changed how we see Mars forever.
details: My project is creative because I did not just list facts about Mars, we gave Sojourner a voice and let it tell its own story. We turned real NASA science into feelings, so the reader feels what it was like to be small, brave, and alone on another planet. By mixing true facts with storytelling, pictures, and emotion, we made a robot feel human and made a 1997 mission feel alive again for a new generation.
